style.checked_requirement: Close color nursery encounter at two photographic distances; L-shaped left scene plus unequal top detail editing; dominant serif Korean Title and medium sans reading system.

evidence.observation: A grower's cropped torso/forearms cradle a planted terracotta pot. The near palm and curled fingers visibly support the pot base; the thumb sits on the near pot wall. Living stems emerge from soil, with smaller planted pots on the bench and a larger established tree receding behind.

Three broad unequal crops show a veined attached leaf, pot rim with gritty soil and upright stems, then rounded leaves with another pot edge. Narrow white gutters divide the close views; they extend the large left image as an L.

The left encounter and top close crops remain substantial connected image masses. The dark large serif Korean Title is the primary verbal anchor inside the L. The scene is an occupied plant bench, not an empty room or tiny accessory beside a headline block.
